name: Taking Care Of Family
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of establishing and maintaining godly family relationships, beginning with the union of husband and wife becoming one flesh as outlined in Genesis 2:24. The responsibility of guiding children and household members in the ways of the Lord is highlighted in Genesis 18:19, while honoring parents is commanded in Exodus 20:12, promising long life. Joshua 24:15 challenges families to choose to serve the Lord together, underscoring a collective commitment to faith. Proverbs further teaches that those who cause strife within their household face emptiness, whereas a righteous man ensures a lasting inheritance for future generations, illustrating the spiritual and practical stewardship involved in taking care of family.
